en: The amount of attention a news event gets; or the protection provided by an insurance policy.
ex: The TV station gave live coverage of the election.
電視台對選舉進行了現場報導。

en: A group of people chosen to represent others; or the act of giving someone the authority to act for you.
ex: A delegation of businessmen visited the city.
一個商人代表團訪問了這座城市。

en: To make something last longer.
ex: The treatment may prolong his life by several years.
這項治療可能讓他多活幾年。

en: Extremely violent, cruel or unkind.
ex: The vicious dog attacked the postman.
那隻兇惡的狗攻擊了郵差。

en: A person who regularly uses a shop or restaurant; or someone who gives money to support the arts or a cause.
ex: The restaurant is popular with local patrons.
這家餐廳深受當地顧客喜愛。

en: A possible effect of an action; or something that is suggested without being said directly.
ex: The decision has serious implications for the company.
這項決定對公司有重大影響。

en: Never having happened or existed before.
ex: The city faced an unprecedented flood last year.
這座城市去年遭遇了史無前例的水災。

en: The upper part of the leg, between the hip and the knee.
ex: He pulled a muscle in his right thigh.
他右大腿的肌肉拉傷了。

en: To be most common or accepted in a place or time; or to win a fight or argument.
ex: We hope that common sense will prevail.
我們希望理性能夠占上風。

en: An abnormal lump or mass of cells in the body.
ex: Doctors removed a small tumor from her lung.
醫生從她肺部切除了一個小腫瘤。

en: A written set of questions given to many people to collect information.
ex: Please fill out the questionnaire before you leave.
離開前請填寫問卷。

en: A greater liking for one thing than another; or a right to be treated first.
ex: Do you have a preference for tea or coffee?
你比較喜歡茶還是咖啡？

en: Including everything or everyone; or a loose coat worn over clothes to keep them clean.
ex: The overall cost of the project was lower than expected.
這個專案的總成本比預期低。

en: The subjects studied in a school or university.
ex: Science is an important part of the school curriculum.
科學是學校課程的重要部分。

en: To include something as part of a larger whole; or to form a legal company.
ex: The new design incorporates ideas from customers.
新設計融入了顧客的點子。

en: A place where dead people are buried, not next to a church.
ex: They laid flowers at the cemetery on Sunday.
他們星期天在墓園獻花。

en: A word or phrase used to describe something by comparing it to something else.
ex: "Life is a journey" is a common metaphor.
「人生是一段旅程」是常見的隱喻。

en: A passage between rows of seats in a theater, church or airplane.
ex: Can I have an aisle seat on the plane?
我可以要飛機上靠走道的座位嗎？

en: Very serious or severe; or quick to notice and understand things.
ex: There is an acute shortage of nurses in the hospital.
這家醫院護理師嚴重短缺。

en: To raise something to a higher standard; or to move to a better class of travel or service.
ex: I upgraded my ticket to business class.
我把機票升級成了商務艙。

en: A clear mineral used in jewelry; or something as clear as glass.
ex: The instructions were crystal clear.
說明書清楚明白。

en: The position of president, or the period during which someone is president.
ex: He won the presidency by a narrow margin.
他以微小差距贏得總統大位。

en: Having a good effect; helpful.
ex: Regular exercise is beneficial to your health.
規律運動對健康有益。

en: The stomach or belly; the tubes inside the body; or great courage; also to remove the inside of something.
ex: My gut feeling told me something was wrong.
我的直覺告訴我有些不對勁。

en: A small group of similar things close together; or to gather in a small group.
ex: A cluster of houses stood near the lake.
一小群房子坐落在湖邊。

en: To put a plan or system into action; or a tool used for a particular purpose.
ex: The company will implement the new system next month.
公司將在下個月實施新系統。

en: Cloth made by weaving or knitting; or the basic structure of a society or building.
ex: This fabric is soft and easy to wash.
這種布料柔軟又容易清洗。

en: Kind and careful not to hurt or bother other people.
ex: It was considerate of you to keep the noise down.
你降低音量真是體貼。

en: The ability to understand a person or situation clearly and deeply.
ex: The book gives readers insight into modern China.
這本書讓讀者深入了解現代中國。

en: A flat case used for carrying papers and documents.
ex: He put the contract in his briefcase and left.
他把合約放進公事包就離開了。

en: Done on purpose; or to think carefully about something before deciding.
ex: It was a deliberate attempt to mislead the public.
這是蓄意誤導大眾的企圖。

en: To keep something within certain limits; or to keep a person or animal in a small space.
ex: Please confine your answers to ten lines.
請把你的答案限制在十行以內。

en: Likely to change; or a quantity in math or science that can change.
ex: Prices are variable depending on the season.
價格隨季節而變動。

en: A very small copy of something; or very small compared with others of its type.
ex: She collects miniature furniture for her dollhouse.
她為娃娃屋收集迷你家具。

en: A limit or boundary; or a jump or spring forward.
ex: Her career has grown by leaps and bounds.
她的事業突飛猛進。

en: Excellent; of the highest quality.
ex: The chef prepared a superb meal for us.
主廚為我們準備了一頓極好的餐點。

en: Formal discussion between people to reach an agreement.
ex: Negotiations between the two sides continued all night.
雙方的談判持續了一整夜。

en: A mark left on the skin after a wound has healed; or to leave a mark on someone.
ex: He has a long scar on his left arm.
他左臂上有一道長疤。

en: To watch and direct an activity or a person to make sure things are done properly.
ex: A teacher supervises the students during lunch.
午餐時間有一位老師看管學生。

en: The best or most exciting part of something; or to draw attention to something important.
ex: The highlight of the trip was visiting the temple.
這趟旅行的亮點是參觀寺廟。
